item.title: KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS
item.description:
An enduring masterpiece of cinema starring Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave, THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption - and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Fully restored and presented uncut and unfiltered as Russell always envisioned, the film screens from a stunning, brand new 35mm print.

item.title: Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood
item.description:
Quentin Tarantino’s Once Upon a Time in… Hollywood visits 1969 Los Angeles, where everything is changing, as TV star Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) and his longtime stunt double Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) make their way around an industry they hardly recognize anymore. The ninth film from the writer-director features a large ensemble cast and multiple storylines in a tribute to the final moments of Hollywood’s golden age.

item.title: Seven
item.description:
Seven, a 1995 American crime thriller directed by David Fincher, follows two detectives, a seasoned veteran named William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) and a rookie, David Mills (Brad Pitt), as they hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives. Director David Fincher and cinematographer Darius Khondji worked with the lab to create a small number of distinctive showcase prints - see one of these rare original CCE Silver Retention 35mm print that provides a deeper black, higher contrast, and added grain.
Cast: Director: David Fincher | Writers: Andrew Kevin Walker | Stars: Morgan Freeman, Brad Pitt, Kevin Spacey
Data: 1995
Durata: 127 minuti
